fact: Decree 2023-160 creates a finance-ministry unit to run the project to acquire, develop and put into operation a new customs information system, with a three-year first stage covering development and testing.
Customs spokesman Chokri Jarraya said on 12 November 2025 that the SINDA 2 customs system will be ready in 2026, with the first applications entering service at the end of 2025.
